note: Fixed reference time per benchmark, in milliseconds. Score = 1000 * ref / median, summed over benchmarks — unbounded, higher is better. Each mark is the fastest median seen the first time that benchmark ran, written back by the runner; because the mark IS the fastest median, every ratio lands in 0-1 and no benchmark can outweigh another.
source: đo lại toàn bộ ở 3 nhân, kiến trúc mỗi ngôn ngữ một container
